productOnPage.descriptionMarkdown:
**_Yoto Says: All ten Yoto Cards in the "My First…" Classical Music series. A brilliant introduction to classical music, and a joy to listen to._**

Featuring the work of some of the most famous composers in the world, this collection of 10 classical music cards has everything your young musician needs to discover a joy of classical music that will last a lifetime.

Tracks included:

*   William Tell Overture by Rossini
*   Swan Lake Waltz by Tchaikovsky
*   Spring from The Four Seasons by Vivaldi
*   Short Ride in a Fast Machine by Adams
*   Berceuse Op 16 by Fauré
*   Suite No. 2 in B minor by Bach
*   Symphony No.5 by Beethoven
*   In the Hall of the Mountain King by Lopez and Grieg
*   Romanian Folk Dances - Braul by Bartók
*   Romanian Folk Dances - Pe loc by Bartók
*   Trumpet Concerto Allegro by Haydn
*   Hungarian Dance No.5 by Brahms
*   The Swan from The Carnival of Animals by Saint-Saëns
*   Études No.21 in G Flat Major by Chopin
*   The Sorcerer's Apprentice by Dukas
*   Slavonic Dance No.8 in G Minor by Dvořák
*   Der Vogelfanger Bin Ich Ja from The Magic Flute by Mozart
*   The Cat from Peter And the Wolf by Prokofiev
*   Divertimiento in F Major Presto by Mozart
*   Russian dance: Petrushka by Stravinsky 
*   The Elephant from The Carnival of Animals by Saint-Saëns
*   Von fremden Ländern und Menschen from Kinderszenen by Schumann
*   Polka from The Golden Age by Shostakovich
*   Harry's Wondrous World from Harry Potter by John Williams

#### Who are Creators on Yoto?

Creators are independent audio makers bringing their original stories, games, songs and more to Yoto Cards. We hand-pick the best and freshest ideas — so every Creators Card meets the Yoto gold standard.

[Explore the Creators Collection](/creators/)
